qualifier: IL-12/IL-10 family plus IL-15/IL-21 and NK cell expansion
name: IL-12/IL-10 family and IL-15/IL-21 cytokine signaling
rationale: All members are signaling by IL-10, IL-12-family (IL-12, IL-23, IL-27, IL-35) or IL-15/IL-21 cytokines and their NK-cell effects, unlike the IL-2/7/9 common-gamma-chain theme or the IL-10/IL-20/type III interferon theme lacking IL-15/IL-21.

qualifier: ventricular trabecular/compact and atrial muscle tissue
name: Ventricular and atrial myocardium morphogenesis and trabeculation
rationale: Members concern formation and development of heart muscle tissue (trabecular and compact ventricular myocardium, atrial muscle, cardiomyocyte proliferation), distinct from endocardium/coronary vessel, septum/second heart field, and cardiomyocyte regeneration themes.

qualifier: prostanoids, leukotrienes, P450 oxylipins and pro-resolving mediators with their receptors
name: Eicosanoid and pro-resolving lipid mediator metabolism and receptors
rationale: Members cover COX, lipoxygenase and P450 production of prostaglandins, leukotrienes, HETEs/EETs and resolvins/protectins/maresins plus their GPCRs, separating it from coagulation, endocannabinoid, LPA receptor and vitamin K themes.

qualifier: psychostimulants acting via dopaminergic transmission
name: Dopamine-mediated reward responses to cocaine, amphetamine and nicotine
rationale: Members are behavioral and cellular responses to cocaine, amphetamine and nicotine, conditioned reward learning and dopaminergic transmission/DARPP-32, unlike themes centred on ethanol, opioid, social behaviors or dopamine receptor coupling.

qualifier: with Hox gene clusters; BCR, interleukin, WNT, keratinocyte targets
name: RUNX-regulated target genes and Hox gene clusters
rationale: Members are RUNX1/2/3 transcriptional target programs (immune, WNT, estrogen receptor, keratinocyte, myeloid) together with Hox gene cluster modules, which the granulopoiesis and RUNX1-megakaryocyte/expression-regulation confusables lack.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase, phospholipase C and beta-arrestin coupling
name: Dopamine receptor signaling via adenylate cyclase, PLC and arrestin
rationale: Members are dopamine receptor subtype signaling routes (cAMP stimulation/inhibition, PLC, beta-arrestin) and their postsynaptic and locomotor outputs, distinct from generic cAMP, dopamine release and drug-reward themes.

qualifier: anoikis and cell death regulation
name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and anoikis regulation
rationale: Members are Hippo pathway, YAP/TAZ transcription and cell-density sensing plus anoikis and autophagic cell death regulation, the latter separating it from confusables sharing the Hippo core with TGF-beta mutants, AP-2, senescence or PTK6.

qualifier: selective autophagy types and autophagosome/endosome-lysosome fusion
name: Selective autophagy and autophagosome-lysosome fusion
rationale: Members cover selective autophagy (pexophagy, reticulophagy, aggrephagy, mitophagy, microautophagy, chaperone-mediated) and lysosomal fusion steps, distinct from mitochondrial dynamics, ESCRT/MVB sorting and endosome-size themes.

qualifier: glucagon receptor-cAMP-PKA axis
name: Glucagon receptor-PKA signaling and islet hormone secretion
rationale: Members are glucagon receptor, adenylate cyclase and PKA signaling and regulation of glucagon and insulin secretion, unlike confusables centred on GLP-1, fatty acid and neurotransmitter control of insulin secretion or gluconeogenesis.

qualifier: translesion synthesis
name: Translesion synthesis and replicative polymerase switching
rationale: Members are translesion polymerases (POLH, POLK, POLI, REV1) and PCNA-based replicative synthesis/gap filling, distinguished from base-excision, telomere C-strand and NER incision themes.

qualifier: myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion
name: Skeletal myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion
rationale: Members regulate myoblast commitment, proliferation, migration, differentiation and fusion in skeletal muscle formation and regeneration, unlike confusables on satellite cell maintenance, muscle atrophy or extraocular muscle.

qualifier: proline and glycine/glyoxylate
name: Proline and glycine-glyoxylate metabolism
rationale: Members are proline synthesis/catabolism and glycine/glyoxylate metabolism, separating it from urea cycle/arginine-ornithine and glutamate/glutamine themes.

qualifier: Wnt/Ca2+ pathway
name: G protein-PLC calcium signaling including Wnt/Ca2+ pathway
rationale: Members are Gq/PLC-IP3 calcium signaling (LPA/S1P receptors, VEGFR2, adenylate cyclase inhibition) plus noncanonical Wnt/Ca2+ modules that purinergic, eicosanoid, PKC and cAMP confusables lack.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase variants and inhibitor resistance
qualifier: ERBB2, EGFR, ALK and FGFR
name: Oncogenic ERBB2, EGFR, ALK and FGFR variants and TKI resistance
rationale: Members are cancer mutants, fusions and amplifications of RTKs with drug resistance, where ERBB2/EGFR mutants are what distinguish it from confusables dominated by KIT, FLT3 and EPO signaling.

qualifier: receptor-SMAD signaling incl. cancer mutants, TGFBR3 and RUNX3
name: TGF-beta superfamily receptor-SMAD signaling and cancer mutants
rationale: Members are TGF-beta, BMP, activin and AMH receptor-SMAD signaling, its regulation and cancer mutants, unlike confusables on Hippo/YAP, miRNA or MET signaling.

qualifier: RHOA/B/C, RHOD/F, RHOG and macropinocytosis
name: RhoA-subfamily, RhoD/F and RhoG cycles with macropinocytosis
rationale: Members are RHOA/B/C, RHOD, RHOF and RHOG GTPase cycles with macropinocytosis and endosomal trafficking, distinct from CDC42/RAC/RND themes and actin-dynamics themes.

qualifier: glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged bases
name: DNA glycosylase recognition and excision of damaged bases
rationale: All members are DNA glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged purines/pyrimidines, the first BER step, whereas confusables cover downstream AP-site processing, gap filling and defective glycosylase variants.

qualifier: cholesterol, very-long-chain fatty acid and ether lipid
name: Cholesterol, very-long-chain fatty acid and ether lipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members are anabolic: sterol synthesis from farnesyl-PP to cholesterol, fatty acid elongation/PUFA metabolism and plasmalogen/wax synthesis, unlike confusables on fatty acid beta-oxidation or early mevalonate steps.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide generation
name: Thyroid hormone synthesis, signaling and peroxide generation
rationale: Members span thyroid hormone generation, transport and receptor signaling plus H2O2/ROS production used in hormone synthesis, separating it from selenium, sulfonation, vitamin C and anion-transporter themes.

qualifier: positive regulation of cytotoxicity and cytokine production
name: Positive regulation of NK cell cytotoxicity and cytokine production
rationale: Members are NK signatures and positive regulation of NK (and T cell) cytotoxicity and cytokine production, unlike confusables on KIR/MHC class Ib inhibitory interactions or T cell activation.

qualifier: Rh glycoprotein ammonium transport
name: Erythrocyte gas exchange and Rh glycoprotein ammonium transport
rationale: Members are erythrocyte O2/CO2/NO transport and Rh-glycoprotein ammonium and CO2 transport, distinct from iron/heme homeostasis, Rh blood group biosynthesis and bicarbonate transport themes.

qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin and leptin; body growth
name: Growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor signaling
rationale: Members are GH, prolactin and leptin receptor JAK-STAT signaling and body growth regulation, unlike confusables on appetite/feeding, thyroid hormone or glucocorticoid secretion.

qualifier: HSF1 heat shock, chaperonin folding and mitochondrial import
name: HSF1 heat shock response, chaperonin folding and mitochondrial protein import
rationale: Members are HSF1-driven heat shock response, chaperone/chaperonin folding and refolding, UPRmt and mitochondrial protein import, unlike confusables on chaperone-mediated autophagy, stress granules or aggrephagy.

qualifier: NOS regulation and NO-cGMP transduction
name: Nitric oxide synthase regulation and NO-cGMP signaling
rationale: All members concern nitric oxide synthase activity and NO-cGMP signal transduction, whereas confusables are about vascular smooth muscle tone and blood pressure outputs.

qualifier: ligand autoprocessing and palmitoylation plus SMO-GLI
name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing, lipidation and SMO-GLI signaling
rationale: Members are Hedgehog ligand self-cleavage, palmitoylation and release plus SMO activation and GLI processing, separating it from Wnt/DVL, Wnt lipidation and Notch themes.
